name: synthetic-fetch-error
description: SYNTHETIC, not recorded against a live key. The documented failed-fetch example on portal.usestring.ai/docs/api-reference/errors (retrieved 2026-10-24): HTTP 502 with {error, statusCode, message}, where `statusCode` is the 403 the destination answered. No x-billed-request-type header — the engine forces zero usage on any non-2xx httpStatus before evidence ever runs, so this fixture also proves that path never needs the header. Serves string#fetch and string#request, which bind the same url. Replace via `deno task record` with a real capture.
